items.note: The old q13 is now q11, reduced to one decision. Section 8 requires showing laziness only with a terminal operation that must visit elements, never count(); keying stream reuse on the exception type, not its message; and a JDK 25 run. This matches Stream.count() and the reuse wording in the Java SE 25 Stream API.

The old q03 is now q01. Section 8 forbids null elements in ArrayDeque items, and stacks-and-queues#o2 (throwing versus null-returning methods) is q01's secondary objective. CME: lists-sets-and-maps-in-depth#o2 is no longer targeted, with a stated reason, and section 8 says no item may assume ConcurrentModificationException is thrown. The List.of objective (o3) is also untargeted, so no unmodifiable-collection key remains at risk.

Section 8 forbids keying a hash-based print order or bucket number for the old q01/q08, now q02/q03. For the old q10, now q04, it states that reversed() reverses the whole chain and that nullsFirst/nullsLast must wrap the key comparator. q03 now reads 'hash code and key comparison' with no bucket index. Minor: only q11 explicitly requires a JDK 25 run. I recommend the private author also run q04's keyed order, but this is not blocking.

Section 5 now lists 12 untargeted objectives with reasons. Recomputed against every topic.json (42 taught objectives excluding the review-scenarios page): the 12 listed equal exactly the 42 minus the 30 blueprint objectives. The objectives in the section 4 table equal the blueprint's objectives set, objectiveFormats keys match, and every reference resolves to an existing objective.
